tonight.headline: Up 28–1 with eight to play: Tate is questionable and 'good to go'; Barkley is out
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate was limited again on Friday and is questionable; the only reassurance is the Titans' own site paraphrasing his coach that he is good to go. Saquon Barkley is officially out. And your opponent has fixed their lineup: ESPN's margin has shrunk from 23 points this morning to 11, 133.5 against 122.3, and your chance from 63% to 56%.

You still lead 28–1 on George Pickens's Thursday night, and your lineup is still the projection lineup. Nothing needs doing today. On Sunday at 09:30, if Tate is on the inactive list, Golden takes his slot.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 14.4, Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7, and Tee Higgins, 12.8, in the flex now that he has practised in full; he is questionable. Love came off Arizona's report on Friday with a full practice. The Cowboys' defence is banked at 1 (archive).

case.label: Your side
case.body: Pickens 28.0, played. To come: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.8, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Loveland 9.7, Myers 8.7, the Jaguars 7.7. Lawrence, Tuten and the defence all play at 07:30 on Sunday in London.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tate's name on the inactive list, on your side. On theirs, Higgins sitting, which costs them about a point against their bench. An 11-point projected lead with eight players each to come is close to even.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: If Tate is inactive: Golden
doFirst.subtitle: Limited again on Friday and questionable, but his coach says he is good to go. Do nothing now; Golden plays at the same hour.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Limited on Thursday and Friday with the back and listed questionable (tennesseetitans.com, 14:31). The team site paraphrases Robert Saleh: he 'had tightness on Thursday' and is 'good to go'. That is the site's wording, not a quote I can show you. RotoWire reads it as 'should play'.

case.label: Why he stays in
case.body: 13.6 against Golden's 12.8 is a coin flip and coin flips go to the projection. Tate faces Houston, who allow receivers the most points in the league, with no corner on their report; Golden faces Chicago, fifth-stingiest.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Golden is Green Bay's lead receiver, not on the injury report, and kicks off at 11:00 like Tate, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate is active and Golden outscores him on Sunday (archive): then the coin flip lost, and no thesis was written on it. If Tate is inactive this card fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Tate is still limited and still questionable
whatWentWrong.lead: Two limited practices on a back he hurt on Thursday. His coach's 'good to go' reaches you as a paraphrase.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: tennesseetitans.com's final report: limited Thursday, limited Friday, questionable. The same site's Friday notes say Saleh called it tightness and him good to go. Tight end Gunnar Helm, hurt the same day, was upgraded to full; Tate was not.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing yet. The one card stays as a fallback with Golden named, and the decision is made from the inactive list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Saturday downgrade to doubtful or out makes Golden the starter that day. His name missing from the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday ends it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jeanty ruled out for several weeks. One missed game changes nothing for this roster.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eight names clear the tool's bar, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Friday sharpened two role reasons, Mitchell's and Roman Wilson's, and neither is a move: you are last in the waiver order and no unprotected seat is open.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation with Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal, none of them on the Chargers' final report (chargers.com, 9 Oct). FantasyPros' Friday column likes him against Denver with Ladd McConkey doubtful to play and Quentin Johnston out. Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third whose team is short of receivers; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is not on Atlanta's final report (atlantafalcons.com, 9 Oct). Brian Robinson's 25.7 last week was three touchdowns behind him on 14 carries (archive; atlantafalcons.com).
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: Not on Green Bay's final report; Chris Brooks (ankle) is out and Pierre Strong Jr. was signed from the practice squad (packers.com, 9 Oct). Guards Aaron Banks and Jacob Monk are doubtful. 7 carries for 13 in Week 4 (archive). Josh Jacobs remains on the exempt list 'without a firm timeline' (Newsweek, 8 Oct). You dropped Lloyd for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — volume at under two yards a carry behind a line missing two guards

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty did not practise on Friday (ankle and foot) and is questionable; Washington starts if he sits (raiders.com; The Big Lead, 9 Oct). 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a one-week starter at most, with no slot here behind Taylor and Tuten
rising.sources: raiders.com · The Big Lead · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint (archive). Moore was not on the field at the start of Friday's practice, a second missed day (CBS/RotoWire citing Joe Buscaglia, 9 Oct); Buffalo's final report comes on Saturday.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting on Monday night

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery, as reported on 5 Oct and carried; nothing new was found. The tool still prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 after DJ Moore left (archive). The role lasts exactly as long as Moore's absence; Moore missed a second practice on Friday and Coleman's own ankle was full on Thursday (buffalobills.com).
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out

rising.name: Roman Wilson
rising.roleReason: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is officially out and not on injured reserve (steelers.com, 9 Oct). Wilson was the second receiver when Pittman sat in Week 2 and drew the same six targets he draws every week (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a real vacancy and, so far, a flat six targets; he is free, so waiting costs no priority

settled.title: 'If Tate is inactive: Golden' (Friday morning's card)
settled.result: Not fired. He was limited again and is questionable; his coach calls him good to go. The card is carried to Sunday's inactive list.

settled.result: Ruled out on Friday and not placed on injured reserve. He was on your bench at 0.0 all week, with Tuten in his slot.

settled.result: Lamb's quad is a bruise, not considered serious, and he should play in Week 6 (Rapoport). The caution stands.

settled.title: Pickens in the flex over Golden (a 0.6 coin flip that went to the projection, Thursday)
settled.result: Live archive: 28.0 on 9 catches from 13 targets, 130 yards and a touchdown. Golden plays on Sunday, so the comparison is not finished; no thesis was written on it either way.

settled.title: 'Put in the claim for George Pickens' (Wednesday's first card)
settled.result: It won, cost the priority, 7th to 10th, and his first game for you scored 28.0. Graded over Weeks 5 to 7 against Downs, who plays on Sunday. One game; the log entry stays open.

settled.title: 'Nobody has explained Tate's back' (Thursday afternoon)
settled.result: It was explainable within hours: a beat writer watched him tweak it in individual drills. The brief did not find that on Thursday.

settled.title: 'Start Tuten in the RB slot, not Gordon' (Tuesday, Wednesday twice, Thursday)
settled.result: Done at 08:44 on Thursday. 14.0 against 10.9; graded on Sunday against Gordon's score.

settled.title: 'You are 7th of ten, so it will probably fail' (Wednesday's edition)
settled.result: It did not fail. Six managers ahead of you passed on a receiver 99% rostered. The forecast was wrong; the recommendation stood either way.

settled.title: 'Swap the Ravens' defence for the Jaguars', free' (Tuesday's and Wednesday morning's card)
settled.result: Done at 12:40 on Wednesday. 4.9 out, 7.7 in. Graded on Sunday against the Ravens' score.

settled.title: 'Strange first, Loveland second' (Wednesday morning's order)
settled.result: You swapped Strange for Loveland at 13:06 on Wednesday. Both project 9.7. Graded on Sunday: the order is wrong if Loveland outscores Strange, and the second move was churn either way.

settled.title: Week 4 final: 63.7 to 78.2
settled.result: Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday (archive). You lost by 14.5. Kamara 22.8, Tate 21.5, Gordon 18.0 and Golden 11.7 on the bench would have scored 61.7 more than the four slots they could have filled. Barkley and Rice were injury exits; the rest was the projection's lineup.

settled.title: Downs in the flex (the projection lineup, 13.6 to Tate's 11.9)
settled.result: Archive: Downs 4.6, Tate 21.5. A coin flip by projection with no thesis written, and it lost by 16.9.

settled.title: 'Darren Waller: do not chase' (Saturday's brief)
settled.result: You added him. Archive: Waller 6.6, Sadiq 0.0. Your move won the week; four days later you dropped him on his bye.

settled.title: 'Gordon: bench, leaning against the claim' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Archive: 18.0 on the bench. The lean was mine and it is withdrawn. He projects 10.9 this week and is on your bench behind Tuten, where the projection puts him.

settled.title: 'Keenan Allen out adds to Downs' share' (3–4 Oct)
settled.result: Allen and Slayton were inactive and Downs drew 4 targets (archive). Closed WRONG.
